annotations.title: Read a sent fact package's status and answers

description: Read the status of a package sent with fact_package_send: for each item, whether the counterparty agreed or disputed it (with their reason and who answered), which items the sender accepted, the reliances recorded, and the package's integrity. For an estoppel it also gives the statement number and text, the tenant's own version where it gave one, the signer's name and title with the electronic signature record (time in UTC, consent wording version and text, SHA-256 of the signed statements, and whether they are unchanged), reliers (each lender or buyer that recorded reliance, its role, the statements and when), and for each relying-party link the first and last time it was opened and how many times, with the name, firm and role given once reliance is recorded and the statements confirmed and disputed at that moment. Give the sender's private status_link (or package_id with token). Needs no account and costs nothing; it reads only your own package, and the counterparty's link cannot read it. The answer also gives attestation (attested or unattested, with the line the pages show: computed by FactLot and unchanged since, or not verified) and package_signature (the outcome of checking the signature fact_package_create's holder made, when there is one). The answer says whether the package was sent in test mode (test_mode true: it does not count in the FactLot record's measure) or for real.

status_link.description: The sender's private status link from fact_package_send.

token.description: The sender's private token (with package_id), if there is no link.
